Name: JIGGLER_BEHAVIOR_TARGET_BONE_RATE_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the target rate for a jiggle bone.

Fields.Name: Rotation %: X-Axis
Fields.Description: Share of this bone's own rotation kept on the X axis. 0: the bone takes the target bone's orientation.

Fields.Name: Rotation %: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: Share of this bone's own rotation kept on the Y axis. 0: the bone takes the target bone's orientation.

Fields.Name: Rotation %: Z-Axis
Fields.Description: Share of this bone's own rotation kept on the Z axis. 0: the bone takes the target bone's orientation.
